name: Fear’s Reach [Psionic]
body:
You have learned how to focus the power of fear to reach enemies too far away to touch.

Prerequisite: Devastating touch class feature, Psionic Shot

Benefit: Your devastating touch ability may now also be used as a ranged touch attack with a range of close (25 ft. + 5 ft. / 2 levels).
